title: Lanternfall
summary: Lanternfall - turn-based tactics roguelite on procedurally generated floating isometric islands: 3-hero squad vs 6 enemy types and the Hollow King, light/shroud system with per-pixel dynamic lighting, shoves into the void, tactical AI, 7-island run with upgrade drafts and route choice, 5 biomes, adaptive synth score, tutorial, undo, persistent save
controls: Mouse to select/move/target, 1-3 abilities, Tab cycle, U undo, D danger zones, Space end turn, Esc cancel, H help, M mute
audio: real-time synthesiser via cpal: parametric SFX voices, procedural 4-layer score that follows battle intensity, stereo delay

tests.unit: 17 tests in src/ (rng, map gen over 300 seeds, save, run, canvas, audio)
tests.e2e: tests/binary_e2e.rs runs the shipped binary --selftest (16 autopilot runs + full app driven by synthetic input to victory) and --screenshot

learnings_from_previous_day: focus axis was visuals: per-pixel lighting, floating-island cliffs, parallax sky, five biome palettes
abilities have a readable defensive payoff (Bulwark, undo, danger overlay)
the boss cannot be cheesed: it can't be shoved, and its aura cancels lantern light
new content keeps arriving: new enemy types on islands 2-4, elites, a new biome every island, the boss on 7
replay comes from choices: an upgrade draft and a route choice after every island
